contents.notes: Replace with an explicit measured hardware profile before publishing benchmark results.

manifest.hypothesis: revoking expert (j,i) invalidates exactly the KV pages of layers above j and nondeterministic routing is never tagged Exact; with deterministic (dropless, batch-invariant) routing, reused KV and outputs are bit-identical to a full prefill of the same prompt under the same expert generations; a nondeterministic-routing negative-control arm that actually attempts reuse is never tagged Exact; the revocation scenario is deterministic and non-vacuous: pages are already cached on both sides of layer j and an expert revocation is actually performed; invalidation is conservative per layer (every layer above j is invalidated even if a particular page would have been unaffected, never the reverse); lagging or lost invalidation and restore or restart never expose stale pages; semantic-input lineage is enforced; the claim is a KV-memory property only; the bitwise claims use seeded random weights with a pinned seed and shape; a mismatching run is never tagged Exact; dependency invalidation (J0): an explicit revocation or a committed supersession, i.e. a generation replacement or edit, of any generation-bearing dependency; every protective mechanism of this experiment triggers on any invalidation, for the dependency kinds it covers (expert generations and semantic inputs); Derived segments are generation-bearing dependencies like semantic and memory inputs: the closed list of dependency kinds is semantic, memory, derived, base model, adapter and expert, narrowed here to the kinds this workload has (see dependency_list_narrowing_reason), and any future generation-bearing segment kind joins by definition; a fence of an expert, whatever its cause, is an invalidating event for KV: every cache entry whose chain includes that expert generation is invalid at the fence's commit index although the generation is unchanged, cache admission checks each chain expert's live serving status besides its generation, and every entry records the per-expert fence epoch it was produced under so a readmitted expert never revives pre-quarantine entries.
manifest.metrics: stale_pages_served, wrongly_dropped_pages, nondeterministic_exact_tags, bitwise_mismatch_count, nondeterministic_reuse_attempts, deterministic_revocation_attempts, pages_above_j_before_revocation, pages_at_or_below_j_before_revocation, deterministic_reuse_events, post_revocation_reuse_probes, retained_pages_reused_after_revocation, recomputed_pages_above_j_served, mismatching_runs_tagged_exact, nondeterministic_divergence_observed, input_revocations_performed, post_revocation_lookups_matching_tokens, revoked_lineage_entry_hits, same_tokens_different_generation_cases, invalidation_suppressed_arms, restore_arms, post_event_lookups, stale_hits, pages_above_j_probed_after_revocation, stale_eligible_entries_before_event, post_event_lookups_on_stale_eligible_entries, expert_generation_revocations_performed, pages_above_layer_cached_before_revocation, matching_post_revocation_lookups, stale_expert_generation_hits, restored_pre_revocation_entries, empty_restart_arm, inflight_expert_revocation_race_cases, outputs_after_expert_revocation, inflight_input_race_cases, outputs_after_input_invalidation, selection_digest_mismatches, procedure_mismatches, probed_page_set_digest, cached_page_set_digest_above_j, inflight_race_cases_by_cell, inflight_outputs_after_invalidation, invalidation_matrix_cases, invalidation_matrix_stale_hits, expert_quarantine_kv_cases, kv_reuse_after_expert_fence, model_pin_mismatches
manifest.baseline: invalidate the whole cache on any expert change
manifest.falsification: The run is invalid (vacuous) and counts as falsified if any coverage prerequisite is unmet: deterministic_revocation_attempts < 1, pages_above_j_before_revocation < 1 or pages_at_or_below_j_before_revocation < 1; deterministic_reuse_events < 1 or nondeterministic_reuse_attempts < 1; post_revocation_reuse_probes < 1, retained_pages_reused_after_revocation < 1 or recomputed_pages_above_j_served < 1; probed_page_set_digest != cached_page_set_digest_above_j (every page above j that was cached before the revocation must be probed: identity-set equality, not count equality); nondeterministic_divergence_observed < 1; input_revocations_performed < 1, post_revocation_lookups_matching_tokens < 1 (on entries whose lineage includes the revoked segment) or same_tokens_different_generation_cases < 1 (same tokens, different segment generation or content_digest); invalidation_suppressed_arms < 1, restore_arms < 1, restored_pre_revocation_entries < 1 (the restored pre-revocation entry must be observed in the catalog before the post-event lookup), stale_eligible_entries_before_event < 1 or post_event_lookups_on_stale_eligible_entries != stale_eligible_entries_before_event (the arm where the revocation is committed but invalidate_inputs or the engine flush is fault-injected to be dropped and the arm where an actual pre-revocation entry (snapshot or tier object) is restored into the catalog must each be run, with post-event lookups targeting exactly the stale-eligible entries, post_event_lookups >= 1; a plain runtime restart is the separate reported arm empty_restart_arm and does not satisfy restore coverage); expert_generation_revocations_performed < 1 (revocation of the generation of expert (j,i) itself), pages_above_layer_cached_before_revocation < 1 or matching_post_revocation_lookups < 1; inflight_expert_revocation_race_cases < 1 (a request using the expert in flight when the expert generation is revoked or superseded) or inflight_input_race_cases < 1; selection_digest_mismatches > 0 (the corpus selection digest recorded in run.json differs from the pinned digest) or procedure_mismatches > 0 (a pinned run-procedure parameter recorded per arm or cell in run.json differs from the pinned value; equality across arms is also compared against the pinned value); inflight_expert_revocation_race_cases and inflight_input_race_cases < 1 for any member of {expert generation, semantic input} x {revocation, supersession} (recorded and required per member, never as one aggregate); inflight_race_cases_by_cell < 1 for any of the four cells {revocation, supersession} x {expert, semantic input} (each cell recorded and reported separately); invalidation_matrix_cases < 1 for any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (config.toml enumerates all 44 cells: dependency kind x invalidation type x path; each cell recorded and required per cell, never as an aggregate); expert_quarantine_kv_cases < 1 (Exact KV populated, then the expert fenced by an authority revocation, then a matching request); model_pin_mismatches > 0 (the base checkpoint (repo and revision), the tokenizer (repo and revision) or the initial MoE topology recorded in run.json differs from the pin in config.toml, or the tiny-model config digest differs). Falsified if any of: stale_pages_served > 0 (a page above j created before the revocation served after it); wrongly_dropped_pages > 0 (a page at or below j dropped because of the revocation); nondeterministic_exact_tags > 0 or mismatching_runs_tagged_exact > 0; bitwise_mismatch_count > 0 between reused KV or outputs and a full prefill of the same prompt under the same expert generations, for deterministic (dropless, batch-invariant) routing, including the post-revocation probes; revoked_lineage_entry_hits > 0 (a hit on an entry whose lineage includes the revoked segment); stale_hits > 0 in the dropped-invalidation arm or the restore arm; stale_expert_generation_hits > 0 (a post-revocation lookup hitting an entry created under the revoked expert generation); outputs_after_expert_revocation > 0 (any output of such a request after the expert invalidation, revocation or supersession) or outputs_after_input_invalidation > 0; inflight_outputs_after_invalidation > 0 in any of the four cells {revocation, supersession} x {expert, semantic input}; invalidation_matrix_stale_hits > 0 in any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (a stale hit, or for in-flight cells an escaped output); kv_reuse_after_expert_fence > 0; any one of the 5 listed seeds misses any criterion above (every seed must pass). Pages recomputed after the revocation are allowed. The pinned model has 4 layers with j = 1, so layers 2 and 3 are above j; invalidation is conservative per layer (every layer above j is invalidated, pages at or below j are retained).
